key_insight: CCS improves radiology report generation by sampling multiple candidate reports and selecting the one with the strongest clinical consensus instead of relying on a single decoded output.
clinical_relevance: This can raise report quality at inference time, with clearer gains on clinical metrics that matter for radiology workflows.
method: Generate multiple candidate reports from a radiology MLLM.
Score candidates using a mix of text-based utilities and an image-grounded multimodal utility.
Select the report with the highest consensus across the rollout pool.
evidence_signal: Across three datasets and multiple radiology MLLMs, CCS consistently outperformed single-path decoding and generic Best-of-N baselines, especially on clinical metrics.
watch_item: Because CCS depends on multiple sampled candidates and an image-report utility model, it may add inference cost and rely on the quality of the multimodal scorer.
paper_title: CCS: Clinical Consensus Selection for Radiology Report Generation
